items.title: 'Why not have go?!' - Dunk's wonder goal against Coventry
items.summary: Match of the Day pundits Danny Murphy and Wayne Rooney take a look at Lewis Dunk's incredible long-range strike in Brighton's 5-0 win against Coventry, praising the defender for his technique.

items.title: OUCH! Cameraman taken out in Packers-Vikings game!
items.summary: A cameraman was wiped out in the first quarter of Green Bay's NFL clash at Minnesota!

items.title: Getting goal decision so wrong is 'baffling' - Rooney
items.summary: Match of the Day pundits Wayne Rooney and Danny Murphy finds it "baffling" that Erling Haaland's winning goal in the Manchester derby was not ruled out by VAR, but think Phil Foden's red card was the correct decision.
